name: specify
description: Formal checks (Quint, TLC, Apalache, Lean) for OpenSpec requirements

scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format
scripts.test: npm run build && find dist/src -name '*.test.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort | xargs node --test
scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc
scripts.prepare: npm run build && (git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true)
